request.description: Registers the signed-in person as the owner of a new partner firm (`kind`: `ca`, `dsa`, `connector`). Works from a partner sign-in without a membership (context `none`, next action `PARTNER_NOT_ONBOARDED`) or from a borrower or partner session. The firm starts `pending`; signing in as a partner returns `PARTNER_PENDING_VERIFICATION` until two staff members verify it. Optional segments, categories (catalog keys), languages (ISO codes) and service areas (`stateGstCode`, `cityId` or `pincode`). One open registration per person.
